review_candidates.description: Our mission We're making Africa the first cashless continent. In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash. We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast. Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in... How You'll Help Us Achieve It Wave is rapidly expanding across Africa, and the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is a key market in our next phase of growth. As we scale our operations, we’re looking for a mission-driven Senior Recruiter to lead hiring efforts in DRC. You’ll play a critical role in attracting, assessing, and closing top talent while helping us build scalable, data-driven recruiting practices in a fast-growing environment. You’ll be part of a globally distributed People team and will help shape how we hire as we launch and grow new teams in-country. In this role, you’ll; Own full-cycle recruitment for a wide range of roles (from sourcing to offer), with a strong focus on leadership and business-critical hiring in DRC. Build and execute sourcing strategies tailored to the Congolese market, while contributing to regional (multi-country) pipelines. Partner closely with hiring managers to understand team needs, define hiring strategies, and deliver high-quality hires quickly in a scaling context. Deliver an exceptional candidate experience, acting as a strong ambassador of Wave’s mission and culture. Continuously improve recruiting processes, proactively identifying bottlenecks and implementing scalable solutions. Use data and analytics to track pipeline health, optimize hiring funnels, and inform decision-making. Ensure high-quality data management in our ATS (Greenhouse) to enable accurate reporting and insights. Design and drive inclusive hiring strategies to build diverse and high-performing teams. Uphold a high hiring bar, ensuring every hire reflects Wave’s values and long-term ambitions. Mentor junior recruiters and contribute to building a strong, collaborative Talent function in the region. Key details The location is primarily based in Kinshasa, with some travel. Work authorization in DRC is required. Our salaries are competitive and calculated using a transparent formula. We support working parents - we offer generous parental leave policies (26 weeks for mothers and 4 weeks for fathers) and subsidized child care when you return to work. We help you live your fullest life now- we subsidize gym memberships and fitness classes. Airtime reimbursement Requirements 6+ years of experience owning end-to-end recruitment processes. 3+ years of in-house recruiting experience in Africa, ideally in high-growth or scaling environments. Strong experience hiring for field and office roles. Deep understanding of local talent markets in DRC (Kinshasa and beyond). Fluency in French and English (required). Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. Strong analytical mindset (comfortable working with metrics, KPIs, and spreadsheets). Ability to operate with autonomy in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment. You might be a good fit if you Thrive in high-growth, build-from-scratch environments. Are passionate about financial inclusion in Africa. Take a data-driven approach to problem-solving and decision-making. Love building networks and engaging talent communities. Are highly adaptable and comfortable navigating complex, evolving environments. Enjoy experimenting and improving processes rather than maintaining the status quo. Are tech-savvy and interested in leveraging tools/automation in recruiting. Are a strong negotiator and closer. Can independently lead projects with minimal oversight. Are excited by launching new markets and scaling teams from the ground up. Are open to travel within the region as needed. Our team We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world. We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most. We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production. We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa. We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue . How to apply Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role. We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals. Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

review_candidates.description: Job Description Senior Estimator Location: Prestwick, Ayrshire Hours: 37 hours per week (half‑day Friday) Type: Full‑time Salary: From £44,348 Travel Required: Occasional Work Location: Site‑based (100%) Security Checks: BPSS, Disclosure Scotland, pre‑employment medical (including drug and alcohol testing) Join One of Ayrshire’s Largest Engineering Employers Prestwick Aerosystems continues Ayrshire’s long‑standing aircraft manufacturing tradition. From our Prestwick site, we manufacture aircraft wing structures used on Airbus commercial aircraft worldwide. You will provide the estimated cost of a product or service using the most reliable sources available and assuming a reasonable degree of accuracy or efficiency. Use a systematic and uniform estimating approach to ensure that all estimates are realistic and competitive and that a prompt and efficient service is provided to the enquirer. You Will How you will contribute to the team Allocate tasks and provide direction and guidance to Estimators as required for the provision of estimates for the construction of competitive quotes for new business and customers ranging from detail parts to major aircraft components and projects. Compile estimates where full engineering definition is available such as drawings and Bills of Materials. Compile estimates using parametric or historical data with reasoned assumptions where minimum engineering data is available. Present estimates, clearly highlighting any assumptions, to others that may not be familiar with the data and issues so that they are readily understood. Liaise with other departments, functions and stakeholders in order to obtain and analyse all required data to complete estimates and quotations. Provide an estimating service to the Projects and Functions for engineering change and cost reduction opportunities. Requirements For The Role You will have: Extensive - Systematic and uniform approach to complete tasks in timely manner. Adequate knowledge to undertake job role with potential to develop further through on job and vocational training. Developed commercial and financial awareness. Ability to communicate written and orally both internally within the business and externally with customers. Ability to manage complex tasks and small projects. Understanding of Contract Terms and legal requirements. Knowledge of export control of data and product requirements.
